findings.title: Missing original PDE attempt arrays are silently skipped
findings.detail: Deleting pde_space4801.prices from the actual 487-array evidence, while metadata still declares that completed original37 PDE attempt, returns integrity pass and initial_quote_gate pass. pde_space4801 disappears from output and eight original stages become seven. A caller can erase a failed or unwanted original attempt without failure.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish PDE stage metadata from non-PDE field/CF diagnostics. Require raw prices/errors/IDs/grids for every declared PDE attempt, preserve failed attempts explicitly, reject duplicate/erased attempt identity. Add a missing-completed-stage-price tamper regression.

findings.title: Docstring claims measured refinement replay but implementation omits it
findings.detail: The module promises measured refinements are recalculated, but stage max_refinement and raw .refinement arrays are never consumed. Changing pde2401x1920 max_refinement to12345 leaves integrity pass and no refinement metric in the result. This does not certify solver correctness, but the current docstring overstates its saved numerical boundary.
findings.recommendation: Either explicitly limit the documented boundary to CF-integral/PDE-query prices and quote errors, or recompute declared stage refinement differences from saved stage prices and compare the metadata/refinement arrays.

limits: Neither initial checker nor this review replays earlier Fourier/PDE solves, certifies Greeks, proves a uniform all-state error bound, or qualifies formal dynamic pilot/Q/P&L.
Hashes are used only for exact source/storage identity; numerical price checks use tolerances.

Both primary and mirror were restored independently through Store.open/restore and all37/eight-stage checker rerun. Existing recovery receipts correctly retain qualification unknown and missing child CPU as null.
The new spatial default1201 passes an independent late-ATM constant-variance Black formula; reference_status remains unmeasured and derivative_error NaN.

Old/new selected-call evidence retains all18 states and the ill-conditioned Heston case at t11/12,S80,v.02. It is not hidden; both versions remain unknown and no state_reference_error is manufactured.
Compact status and reviewer-owned replay module were outside this review.
